subject: Pricing & procurement path for BrightApps - PO vs card, marketplace, hosted/dedicated/private
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@brightapps.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@brightapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps - procurement & pricing path (BrightApps)

Thanks again for the call earlier today - great to meet, Samantha and Rajiv. Quick recap and suggested next steps on the procurement path so your team can share with legal/procurement.

1) Procurement preference (PO vs card)
- You mentioned procurement prefers PO for production and will want to route to finance (Rajiv) for approval. For a short pilot we can accept card to speed initial testing.

2) Marketplace interest
- You asked about AWS Marketplace: we are live on the marketplace for a subset of configurations and can provide an AMS listing link; full marketplace listing (commercial terms accepted) may take additional procurement steps.

3) Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
- Pilot: Hosted (Redwood API, pay-by-card) - fast to start, minimal setup.
- Production: Dedicated (reserved capacity) - recommended for predictable cost & latency; available with 6/12/24 month commits.
- Regulated: Private (VPC/on-prem) - available if you need strict network controls / on-prem.

4) Pricing & packaging notes (attached)
- Attached: pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx with example commit discount bands and RDW_PO_template.pdf + procurement_checklist.pdf and SOW-draft.docx.

Next steps
- Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether PO terms (net30/45) are required?
- If PO path, are there any standard contract addenda (e.g., custom indemnities or data residency clauses)?
- Would you like Aditya (cc'd) to join a short call with procurement to walk through the SOW and pricing?

Thanks - I'll coordinate internally to prepare a compact one-pager for procurement and an example SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment(s): procurement_checklist.pdf, pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@brightapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@brightapps.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps - procurement & pricing path (BrightApps)

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few items from procurement side: 

- Procurement preference: PO for anything > $10k/month. For a 4-6 week pilot we can use card and treat it as a proof-of-concept.
- Timeline: likely 30-45 days once we hand materials to legal/procurement.
- Compliance: We require SOC 2 Type II report and standard data processing addendum. We also prefer services hosted in us-east-1 for data residency.
- Marketplace: yes, we prefer marketplace purchases if your listing supports procurement workflows (PO & consolidated billing). If you can share marketplace listing details that would help.

Also please send a sample SOW and the PO template (we'll try to run that through finance this week). If possible include a short note on commit discounts and how billing migrates from hosted (card) pilot to dedicated committed instances (does usage transfer or do we need a new billing relationship?).

Can Aditya join a call early next week? Rajiv and I are available Tues/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Head of Procurement | BrightApps Inc
samantha.green@brightapps.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@brightapps.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@brightapps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps - procurement & pricing path (BrightApps)

Great - thanks for the details, Samantha. Answers below and next steps.

- SOC 2 / DPA: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA. I'll upload the SOC report to a secure Drive link (see related links) and can provide a vendor access method for procurement.

- Marketplace: We have an AWS Marketplace listing for our hosted API SKU already; marketplace purchase workflows for Dedicated are more complex and sometimes require a custom listing. For procurement speed, the most common path customers take is:
   1) Pilot on Hosted (card) for dev/test - immediate access.
   2) Move to Dedicated Reserved Capacity (PO + commit) for production - billing moves to a committed contract; usage from the pilot does not automatically convert but we provide crediting options on a case-by-case basis (we can include a pilot credit in the contract).

- Commit & discount bands (high level; see attached pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx):
   * On-demand hosted: standard pay-as-you-go (card).
   * Dedicated commits:
       - 6-month commit: ~10% discount vs list
       - 12-month commit: ~20% discount vs list
       - 24-month commit: ~30% discount vs list
   * Private (VPC/on-prem): pricing is quote-based and typically includes an onboarding fee and annual platform license.

- PO terms: we can accept net30 or net45 depending on the legal review. We'll include our RDW_PO_template.pdf to align finance teams.

Attachments included: RDW_PO_template.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx, procurement_checklist.pdf.

Next steps
- Aditya, can you and Neha review the SOW and pricing sheet and join a procurement sync with Samantha/Rajiv on Tue/Wed mornings PST?
- Samantha/Rajiv, if you can share the contact for procurement/legal we'll route the SOC 2 and DPA directly.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment(s): RDW_PO_template.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: BrightApps procurement - pricing/packaging alignment before procurement call

Internal notes before Tue call with procurement: please keep this thread internal.

- Recommended commercial path: pilot on hosted (card) up to $5k/month for 4-6 weeks, then production on Dedicated with a 12-month commit as default for predictable economics. Offer pilot credit equal to one month of average usage if they convert to a committed term.
- Discount language: avoid exact list price commitments in email; use tier bands and reference the pricing_tiers_summary.xlsx. For procurement we should provide a clear one-pager that maps pilot -> PO -> committed billing and how credits apply.
- Marketplace ask: mention that marketplace purchase is supported for hosted SKUs; for Dedicated we need to discuss marketplace procurement separately - marketplace often requires additional procurement paperwork (AWS AMI/SAAS contract).
- Docs to prepare: concise procurement one-pager, finalized SOW-draft.docx, SOC2 redacted report. Upload the SOC2 to secure Drive and share the link with procurement.

Aditya/neha: Can one of you create the procurement one-pager and confirm the discount wording we should share? I'll coordinate scheduling with Samantha/Rajiv (Tue/Wed morning PST).

Thanks - Marissa
